titles.title: Black Diagonal

description: Vertical charcoal drawing with strong thick black line that runs diagonal across the page from the lower left increasing in thickness to the upper right.  Through the middle is a more delicate curved line and a spiraling circular shape in the middle crossed by the main black line.
